title: The Telangana Municipalities (Amendment) Bill, 2024
summary: 'The Telangana Municipalities (Amendment) Bill, 2024' (L.A. Bill No. 4 of 2024) is a State legislative measure introduced in the Telangana Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) concerning Municipal Administration & Urban Development. The bill amends statutory provisions to update legal frameworks, adjust compliance requirements, or alter state administrative procedures.
full_text:
THE TELANGANA MUNICIPALITIES (AMENDMENT) BILL, 2024
L.A. Bill No. 4 of 2024
A Bill further to amend the Telangana Municipalities Act, 2019.

Be it enacted by the Legislature of the State of Telangana as follows:-
1. Short title.- This Act may be called the Telangana Municipalities (Amendment) Act, 2024.
2. Rationalization of urban layout development permissions, open space reservation, and municipal building penalties.
3. Enactment of single-window digital building approval systems across Municipal Councils and Corporations.

STATEMENT OF OBJECTS AND REASONS
Urban areas in Telangana are witnessing unprecedented expansion. This amendment streamlines building permissions, protects public utility spaces, and reduces compliance delays for citizens and developers.
